visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a hand reaching toward a black industrial machine with gauges and a brass valve. As the hand pulls the valve, a high-pressure stream of dark brown, rusty liquid sprays out onto a light blue paper towel resting on a wooden-textured floor. The lighting is bright and localized, highlighting the metallic sheen of the compressor and the wetness of the spray. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a man wearing a black hoodie, a baseball cap, and glasses, squatting in a workshop environment. The background is densely packed with shelves containing hundreds of small paint bottles, hobby tools, and organizational bins. The man gestures toward the black Sparmax air compressor, explaining its function and the need for maintenance. (3) A close-up returns to the compressor's lower valve. The man's hand pulls the ring, causing a massive, violent eruption of orange-brown liquid that splashes across the floor and covers the camera lens. The liquid droplets are highly saturated against the neutral floor. (4) The camera pans up to show the man's face, wide-eyed with shock and amusement as he realizes the scale of the mess. He starts laughing and picks up a yellow cloth, beginning to wipe the floor and the side of the machine. The setting remains the same cluttered workshop with bright, flat overhead lighting. (5) In a series of close-up shots, the man uses a blue cloth to shield the valve as he releases more air and rusty residue, attempting to contain the spray. The cloth becomes increasingly stained with orange spots. (6) The video concludes with the man facing the camera directly, holding a hobby accessory. He delivers a final piece of advice about regular cleaning while standing in front of his detailed workstation, with warm artificial lighting accentuating the professional hobbyist setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, high-pressure percussive hiss followed immediately by the splashing sound of liquid hitting a surface. The main male speaker delivers a short introductory phrase in an energetic, casual tone. (2) A medium-tempo electronic BGM track enters, featuring a steady synth beat. The speaker continues with clear, fast-paced narration about technical maintenance, punctuated by a brief mechanical click from the machine. (3) A loud, explosive SFX of air and liquid spraying occurs, triggering a sudden high-arousal exclamation from the main speaker and a secondary male voice. (4) Both men break into loud, genuine laughter. Sounds of rhythmic fabric rustling follow as a cloth is used for wiping. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) Another sustained hissing sound of escaping air dominates the mix, accompanied by more laughter and casual dialogue between the two males. (6) The speech density increases as the speaker summarizes the experience, maintaining a high-energy but informative tone until the BGM fades out at the end.
